production_interaction_evidence: Events exposed three RTL rail-control groups. After hydration every overflowing rail started with previous disabled and next enabled.
The events region rail moved from scrollLeft 0 to -290, enabled previous, and stopped at -764 with next natively disabled.
Search exposed both discovery rails with correct initial boundaries and no document-level horizontal overflow.
A live result-card gallery moved from 1/5 to 2/5 and enabled previous.
The live vacation-1597 hero gallery started at 1/97 with previous disabled, moved to 2/97, and had no 390-pixel horizontal overflow.
The full story gallery opened with 98 images, started with previous disabled, enabled it after movement, and stopped after 97 moves with next disabled.

The production QA matrix completed homepage, events, search, mobile and English LTR rail checks before a repeated second navigation to /search timed out. Direct in-app browser checks then completed result-card, hero and full-gallery interaction evidence.

Sleeping-arrangement controls are present in the deployed source but no accepted current public vacation record rendered that optional family during production sampling; its boundary behavior passed local browser and source-contract tests.

independent_review.evidence: Verified all six HTTP routes, ten homepage control groups, event and search rails, RTL, desktop and 390-pixel mobile non-overflow, live detail hero, result-card and full-gallery presence. The checker independently exercised one rail movement and documented that exhaustive terminal clicks and LTR switching were supplemented by the primary production and automated evidence.
